title: Nadir
summary: NADIR, noun 1. Natara, to be like, proportional, corresponding to, opposite. 2. That point of the heavens or lower hemisphere directly opposite to the zenith; the point directly under the place where

inlines.v: NADIR, noun 1. Natara, to be like, proportional, corresponding to, opposite. 2. That point of the heavens or lower hemisphere directly opposite to the zenith; the point directly under the place where we stand.
